ashe/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/ashe_sta.name: PinB.O.B.

bastion/minorPerks/assets/perks/bastion_.name: Smart Bomb

bastion/minorPerks/assets/perks/bastion_.name: Configuration Reload

bastion/majorPerks/assets/perks/bastion_.name: Self-Repair

cassidy/minorPerks/assets/perks/cassidy_.name: Bang Bang

cassidy/minorPerks/assets/perks/cassidy_.name: Giddy Up

cassidy/majorPerks/assets/perks/cassidy_.name: Rollin' Round-Up

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Gunslinger Grit

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Bullseye
cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.description: Flashbang hits and Critical hits reduces Combat Roll's cooldown by 2s.

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Barrage Blastin'

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Silver Bullet

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Buck Wild
cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.description: Dealing damage with Peacekeeper grants 1% Move Speed for 5s, stacking up to 15 times. At max stacks, gain 10% Damage Reduction.

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Barrel Roll

cassidy/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/cassi.name: Hot Potato

echo/minorPerks/assets/perks/echo_minor_.name: Aerial Munitions

freja/minorPerks/assets/perks/freja_mino.name: Relentless Barrage

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Carpet Bomb
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: +40% Barrage Move Speed.­ Barrage has 50% increased duration.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Cyclic Salvo
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: Rocket Launcher direct hits grant 10 fuel and reduce your cooldowns by 1s.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Blitz Barrage
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: +40% Barrage Move Speed.­ After using Jet Dash, fire a Barrage with 75% fewer Mini-Rockets.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Fuel Depot
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: Rocket Launcher direct hits permanently increase your maximum fuel by 2, stacking up to 25 times.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Nosedive
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: Ability: While Airborne, use Crouch to dash towards the ground and restore 50% fuel. ­ (6s Cooldown).

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Heat Seekers
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: After using Jet Dash, your next Primary Fire locks onto enemies.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Launch Vector
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: Whenever you knockback an enemy with Concussive Blast, fire 3 homing Mini-Rockets at them.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Speed Kills
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: Dealing Weapon Damage grants 5% Move Speed and 3% Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 6 times. Direct hits grant double stacks.

pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.name: Triple Volley
pharah/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/pharah.description: After using an ability or Gadget, your next Primary Fire fires 3 rockets that each deal 40% damage.

reaper/minorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_mi.name: Soul Reaving
reaper/minorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_mi.description: Collect Soul Globes from dead enemies to restore 50 health.

reaper/minorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_mi.name: Lingering Wraith
reaper/minorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_mi.description: Leaving Wraith Form grants 30% movement speed for 2 seconds.

reaper/majorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_ma.name: Shadow Blink
reaper/majorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_ma.description: Shadow Step's cast time and cooldown are 25% faster, but the range is reduced by 25%.

reaper/majorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_ma.name: Trigger Finger
reaper/majorPerks/assets/perks/reaper_ma.description: Refresh Dire Triggers' cooldown whenever using an ability or reloading.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Revolving Ruin
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: Close-range (7m) Hellfire Shotgun hits grant 5% Attack Speed for 1s, stacking up to 10 times.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Shrouded Shrapnel
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: Using Wraith Form increases the number of pellets per shot in your next magazine by 25% and its spread by 50%.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Death Step
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: After using Shadow Step, cast Death Blossom for 1.5s with 50% reduced damage.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Strangle Step
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: +15% Shadow Step Cast Speed.­ After using Shadow Step, double your Lifesteal for 3s.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Spirited To Slay
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: Eliminations reduce the cooldown­ of Wraith Form by 50% and Shadow Step by 100%.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Bloodletters
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: Dire Trigger deals 30 additional damage over 3s to Airborne enemies and to enemies beyond 8m.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Wraith Renewal
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: While in Wraith Form, restore 7% of your Life every second. Double this while below 50% Life.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Hellshroud
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: While in Wraith Form, passing through enemies Burns them for 20% of your Max Life and slows their Move Speed and Attack Speed by 20% for 2s.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Wall of Life and Death
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: While in Wraith Form, become 50% larger and block incoming projectiles while healing all other allies within 6m for 35 every 1s.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Harvest Fest
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: Hellfire Shotgun hits have a 20% chance to spawn a Soul Globe. When picked up, restore 15% Life, 15% Ammo, and gain 15% Move Speed for 3s.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Trigger Finger
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: After using an ability or Gadget or reloading, refresh Dire Triggers cooldown.

reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.name: Wretched Wings
reaper/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/reaper.description: While using Wraith Form, gain the ability to fly.­ While airborne, Jump to glide.

shion/minorPerks/assets/perks/shion_mino.name: Survival Instinct
shion/minorPerks/assets/perks/shion_mino.description: Evade's overhealth duration is increased by 1 second.

shion/minorPerks/assets/perks/shion_mino.name: X Machina
shion/minorPerks/assets/perks/shion_mino.description: Execution does 20% more damage to enemies below half health.

shion/majorPerks/assets/perks/shion_majo.name: Refuel
shion/majorPerks/assets/perks/shion_majo.description: Joyride instantly restores 50 health and regenerates 20 health per second while active.

shion/majorPerks/assets/perks/shion_majo.name: Faces of Death
shion/majorPerks/assets/perks/shion_majo.description: Gain all other Damage subrole passives (Recon, Specialist, and Sharpshooter).

sierra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_mi.name: Full Flight
sierra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_mi.description: Increase Anchor Drone flight and grapple ranges by 25%.

sierra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_mi.name: Tight Grip
sierra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_mi.description: Helix Rifle's bullet spread tightens 70% faster and widens 30% slower.

sierra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_ma.name: Medi-Drone
sierra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_ma.description: Anchor Drones hold a medkit that can heal Sierra.

sierra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_ma.name: Locked In
sierra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sierra_ma.description: Hitting an enemy with Tracking Shot increases your attack speed by 20% for 2 seconds.

sojourn/minorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.name: Overcharged
sojourn/minorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.description: Railgun's maximum energy is increased by 50 while Overclock is active.

sojourn/minorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.name: Deceleration Field
sojourn/minorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.description: Enemies hit by Disruptor Shot are slowed by 25%.

sojourn/majorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.name: Friction Generators
sojourn/majorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.description: Power Slide generates up to 75 energy.

sojourn/majorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.name: Dual Thrusters
sojourn/majorPerks/assets/perks/sojourn_.description: Power Slide gains an additional charge and its jump height shifts to lateral movement.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Unconventional Tactics
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Power Slide spawns a mini Disruptor Shot when you start sliding and when you jump out of Power Slide.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Commotion Cycle
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Dealing damage with Charged Shot refunds up to 35% of your ability cooldowns, based on the Railgun Charge spent.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Experimental Tech
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Disruptor Shot slows enemies within its area for 25%. Gain Railgun Charge equal to 50% of ability damage dealt.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Overcharge
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Maximum Railgun Charge increased to 150. Fully-charged attacks and abilities still only consume up to 100 Charge.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Fine-Tuned Thrusters
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: +1s Power Slide Duration.­ Eliminations reset Power Slide cooldown.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Drill Kick
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: +50% Power Slide Speed.­ During Power Slide, gain 25% Damage Reduction and deal 75 damage to nearby enemies.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Hard Stuck
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Disruptor Shot can stick to enemies. Stuck Disruptor Shots deal 25% less damage.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Enhanced Targeting System
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: During Overclock, Railgun's Primary Fire auto-aims at enemies.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Dynamic Dispatch
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: During Power Slide and the jump after, gain 50% Charged Shot projectile size, 35% Attack Speed, and 35% Weapon Lifesteal.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Aftershock
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Fully-charged Charged Shot or Charged Shot critical hits trigger an explosion, dealing 50% damage to other nearby enemies.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Zoom Zoom Zoom
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: Gain an additional Power Slide charge.

sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.name: Conductor Chase
sojourn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/sojou.description: During Power Slide and the jump after, gain 10% Railgun Charge and restore 50% of your Max Ammo every 1s. Railgun Charge decays 75% slower.

soldier-76/minorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.name: Helix Propulsion
soldier-76/minorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.description: Helix Rockets' projectile speed is increased by 50%.

soldier-76/minorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.name: Tactical Salvo
soldier-76/minorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.description: During Tactical Visor, Helix Rockets' cooldown is reduced by 80% and no longer interrupts firing Heavy Pulse Rifle.

soldier-76/majorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.name: Full Stride
soldier-76/majorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.description: Sprint's movement speed bonus gradually increases by an additional 25% over 2 seconds.

soldier-76/majorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.name: Stim Pack
soldier-76/majorPerks/assets/perks/soldi.description: Stim Pack replaces Biotic Field. On use, Soldier: 76 heals for 30 health per second and gains 20% increased attack speed for 5 seconds.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Super Visor
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: After using Helix Rocket, activate Tactical Visor for 0.5s.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Peripheral Pulse
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: During Tactical Visor, Pulse Rifle auto-aims at 1 additional enemy, dealing 50% reduced damage.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Run and Gun
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: Shooting Pulse Rifle and using abilties doesn't interrupt Sprint. ­ Dealing damage during Sprint grants 1% Sprint Move Speed and Lifesteal for 5s, up to 25%.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Chaingun
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: While continuously shooting Pulse Rifle, each shot grants 0.5% Weapon Power, stacking up to 100 times.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Double Helix
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: Helix Rocket fires a second homing Helix Rocket that deals 70% reduced damage.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Cratered
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: Increase Helix Rocket explosion radius by 40% and explosion damage by 15%.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Hunker Down
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: When Helix Rocket deals damage, create a Biotic Field with 50% reduced duration and 50% reduced effectiveness at your position.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Aura Cloud
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: +40% Biotic Field Radius.­ Enemies within your Biotic Field take damage equal to 100% of its healing.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Track and Field
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: During Sprint, abilities refresh 75% faster and you restore 15% Max Ammo every 1s.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Frontliners
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: Allies in range of your Biotic Field when it spawns gain Overhealth equal to 25% of your max Life for 2s.

soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.name: Biotic Bullseye
soldier-76/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/so.description: While in Biotic Field, gain 50% more Ultimate Charge and critical hits restore 20% Max Ammo and extend the duration of Biotic Field by 0.5s, up to 5s.

sombra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_mi.name: Life Hack
sombra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_mi.description: EMP applies Hotfix to all nearby allies.

sombra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_mi.name: CTRL ALT ESC
sombra/minorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_mi.description: Teleporting with Translocator while below half health initiates passive health regeneration.

sombra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_ma.name: Data Packet
sombra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_ma.description: Hacking health packs with Hotfix reduces its main cooldown by 4 seconds.

sombra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_ma.name: Cybersecurity
sombra/majorPerks/assets/perks/sombra_ma.description: Cyberspace's healing is doubled on allies below half health.

symmetra/minorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.name: Sentry Capacity
symmetra/minorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.description: Sentry Turret gains an additional charge.

symmetra/minorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.name: Perfect Alignment
symmetra/minorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.description: Increase the range of Photon Projector's primary fire by 20%.

symmetra/majorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.name: Hovering Barrier
symmetra/majorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.description: Teleporter gains the option to create a forward moving barrier instead. Pressing E again slows down the barrier's movement.

symmetra/majorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.name: Shield Battery
symmetra/majorPerks/assets/perks/symmetr.description: Symmetra regenerates 20 shields per second while within 10 meters of her teleporter.

torbjorn/minorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.name: Hammer Time
torbjorn/minorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.description: Move 20% faster while Forge Hammer is equipped.

torbjorn/majorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.name: Anchor Bolts
torbjorn/majorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.description: Deploy Turret's throw range is increased by 25% and it can now attach to walls and ceilings.

torbjorn/majorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.name: Overloaded Turret
torbjorn/majorPerks/assets/perks/torbjor.description: Overload upgrades your Turret for 5 seconds, increasing its health and damage.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: All Grown Up
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: While Overload is active, Turrets are upgraded 1 Level to a maximum of Level 3.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Swedish Sauna
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Molten Core heals allied heroes within it for 50% of Molten Core Damage every 1s.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Magmini
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: When you use Overload, gain 2 Ammo of Molten Core with 66% reduced damage and duration.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Come Get Yer Armor
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: When you use Overload, throw 2 Armor Packs that grant Armor equal to 15% of your Max Life. Armor Packs do not stack.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Let Off Some Steam
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: While Overload is not active, Weapon Damage and Weapon Healing reduces Overload Cooldown by 8%.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Forged In Fire
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: While Overload is active, every Forge Hammer swing explodes, dealing bonus damage equal to 10% of your Max Life in a 3m radius.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Dwarlord
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Overload grants all allies within 5m Overhealth equal to 50% of Overload Overhealth and 10% Attack Speed.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Riveting
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Every 5th Rivet Gun shot shoots both your Primary Fire and Secondary Fire. The bonus shot deals 10% reduced damage.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Blacksmith
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Hitting an ally with Forge Hammer heals them for 100% of ­ Forge Hammer damage.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Hammer Throw
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Ability: While Forge Hammer is equipped, use Secondary Fire to throw it. It has 200% effectiveness on Turrets and allies.­ (2s Cooldown).

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Turriplets
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: You can have 3 Turrets active. They start at Level 1, have 50% Health and 65% Attack Speed, and can be upgraded temporarily with Forge Hammer hits for up to 24s.

torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.name: Clocked
torbjorn/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/torb.description: Turret damage marks enemies for 8s. Gain 25% Weapon Lifesteal and 15% increased Weapon Damage against marked enemies.

tracer/majorPerks/assets/perks/tracer_ma.name: Quantum Entanglement
tracer/majorPerks/assets/perks/tracer_ma.description: Recall grants 50 overhealth and 20 ammo that decays over time.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Flash Fist
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: For 1s after using Blink, your next Quick Melee is affected by Ability Power, deals 25 extra damage, and knocks enemies back.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Quantum Clip
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: If you use Blink while reloading,­ gain 25% Max Ammo and 10% Weapon Lifesteal until you reload.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Auto Recall
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: Once per round, if you would die, instead use Recall for free.­ Spending your Ultimate Charge reduces Recall's cooldown by 50%.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Timelapse
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: Hitting 2 consecutive shots on the same target without missing deals 2 extra damage over 2s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Get Stuffed!
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: Quick Melee hits grant 5% Ultimate Charge and reduces Recall cooldown by 2s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Quantum Reload
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: After Recalling, gain Ammo equal to 100% Max Ammo that decays over time.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Blink Hop
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: Blink teleports you 3m farther.­ If you use Blink while airborne, gain an air jump and reduce Blink cooldown by 0.2s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Temportal
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: Recalling leaves behind a Temporal Portal for 8s. Up to 3 allies can Interact with it once to Recall back in time 1s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Impulsive
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: When you use Recall, throw a Pulse Bomb that detonates 50% faster but deals 70% less damage.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Alternate Ending
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: When you use Recall, heal allies within 6m for 100% of the damage they have taken in the last 3s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Bullet Time
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: When you use Recall, drop a Temporal Field that slows projectiles by 95% and enemies for 20%.­ You take 25% less damage from Hitscan for 4s.

tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.name: Chrono Stabilizer
tracer/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/tracer.description: After you use Blink, heal allies within 6m for 40 and yourself for 10.

vendetta/minorPerks/assets/perks/vendett.name: Raging Storm
vendetta/minorPerks/assets/perks/vendett.description: Whirlwind Dash continues to spin, hitting 3 more times for 30 damage in a wide area.

vendetta/majorPerks/assets/perks/vendett.name: Relentless
vendetta/majorPerks/assets/perks/vendett.description: Onslaught can stack 3 more times, increasing attack speed by 5% and movement speed by 3% per stack.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Rampant Onslaught
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Onslaught's maximum stacks are increased by 1 after every 2 eliminations, up to 3.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Undying Fury
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: If you would die, instead become Hindered and prevent ally healing, gain decaying Overhealth equal to your Max Life, and double your Onslaught stacks and Lifesteal. ­ (90s Cooldown).

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Skycut
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: After using Soaring Slice, your next Overhead Strike shoots a Projected Edge with 75% damage when landing.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Overloaded Strike
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: After using Soaring Slice, your next Airborne Overhead Strike can channel a level 1 Sundering Blade with 25% increased damage.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Defiance Core
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Warding Stance energy regenerates now even while blocking at 75% rate.­ For every Projected Edge fired, reduce Whirlwind Dash and Soaring Slice cooldown by 0.5s.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Riposte
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: After blocking damage, remove Warding Stance's Move Speed penalty. Your next swing becomes an Overhead Strike.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Cyclone Charge
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Whirlwind Dash can spin 3 additional times, dealing 75% damage.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Double Dash
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: After Whirlwind Dash is finished, it can be reactivated within 3s for 75% damage.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Exalted Empress
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: After using Soaring Slice, Overhead Strike and Sundering Blade give 30% of damage as Overhealth, up to 200.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Cataclisma
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Projected Edge and Soaring Slice explode on enemy hit, dealing 30 damage to enemies within 4m.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Furious Friction
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Warding Stance has 25% increased energy regeneration rate. ­ When you deal damage with Projected Edge gain an additional 50% for 3s.

vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.name: Apex Bloodlust
vendetta/stadiumPowers/assets/perks/vend.description: Gain 4% Lifesteal and your abilities refresh 3% faster for each Onslaught stack you have.

venture/minorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.name: Deep Burrow
venture/minorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.description: Drill Dash distance is 75% longer while burrowed.

venture/minorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.name: Excavation Exhilaration
venture/minorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.description: While Tectonic Shock is active, cooldowns refresh 300% faster.

venture/majorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.name: SMART Extender
venture/majorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.description: Empower SMART Excavator with E to increase its maximum projectile range by 100% for 4 seconds.

venture/majorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.name: Covered In Dirt
venture/majorPerks/assets/perks/venture_.description: Dealing damage with Clobber grants up to 40 Explorer's Resolve shields.

widowmaker/minorPerks/assets/perks/widow.name: Scoped Efficiency
